info.name: Getting Started with the Loket RESTful API

body.raw:
Technical documentation regarding OAuth2 code flow: https://developer.loket.nl/OAuthCode 

Please note that you will need to have both client and user credentials to perform these actions.

If you do not have these credentials yet, please check the information on https://www.loket.nl/koppelen-met-loket/

item.name: 1. Code flow authorization url: please copy-paste the resulting url in your internet browser
2. Acquire refresh_token using authorization_code (please store your refresh_token)
